content.text:
## What happened

Every page was silently falling back to the system font. In `site/css/tokens.css:5`, the `@font-face` rule pointed at the wrong directory:

```css
src: url('../font/acme-sans.woff2')   /* 404 */
```

The actual file lives in `site/fonts/acme-sans.woff2` (plural). Since that stylesheet is shared by all six pages, the browser requested a 404 on each page and substituted `system-ui`, changing the typography site-wide — the layout and colors were untouched, which is why it just looked "off" rather than broken.

Note: the repo only has the single initial commit, and tracked files matched it, so the typo came in with that commit rather than a separate local edit — there was no earlier known-good revision in git to diff against.

## The fix

Changed the URL to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`.

## Verification

- Browser audit across all six pages: the font request now returns 200, `document.fonts.check('16px "Acme Sans"')` is `true`, and there are **no other failed/4xx resource requests**.
- Full-page screenshot confirms Acme Sans is rendering (tighter text metrics than the fallback).
- `npx playwright test tests/functional.spec.ts`: **16 passed**.

The temporary audit spec I used was removed; the only working-tree change is the one-line CSS fix.

STATUS: DONE
